The calendar-date candidate node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes submissions before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The source separately states a date-effective channel rule, a 9:00am launch and blackout ending, and resubmission following implementation. Preserve the competing interpretations; the date-only predicate cannot distinguish that morning's blackout from operational launch.

The timestamp-based candidates select the operational-launch interpretation. The governing timezone is not expressly supplied, and the date-effective wording should not silently be treated as identical to the launch-instant wording.
Urgent blackout contact is expressly allowed but does not itself establish an actual STR submission. Migration and later resubmission likewise must not be treated as original submission events.

The history candidate answers whether a triggering event ever existed, not whether a resubmission duty remains outstanding after performance. Its externally supplied aggregate requires sufficient history to justify FALSE.
